subtitle: Saba ishuri ryawe kugutumira, cyangwa utwoherereze amakuru yaryo.
title: Shakisha ishuri ryawe

copy.eachSchoolOnImboniIsKeptCompletelySepara: Buri kigo kuri Imboni gitandukanye burundu, kugeza no ku bubiko bwacyo bwite. Aderesi y'urubuga rw'ikigo cyawe ni yo ibwira sisitemu ikigo ubarizwamo, bityo amakuru y'ikigo kimwe ntashobora kugaragara mu kindi.
copy.theEmailListsEverySchoolYourAddressIsReg: Imeri irimo ibigo byose aderesi yawe yanditsemo. Niba nta kintu kigeze mu minota mike, reba mu mabaruwa atifuzwa, hanyuma ubaze ibiro by'ikigo cyawe aderesi bafite.
copy.useTheAddressYourSchoolHasOnFileForYouFo: Koresha aderesi ikigo cyawe kibitse. Ku mubyeyi akenshi ni iyo ikigo kimwandikiraho; ku bakozi n'abanyeshuri ni imeri y'ikigo.
copy.whyDoesMySchoolHaveItsOwnAddress: Kuki ikigo cyanjye gifite aderesi yacyo?
